name: 55448 · Coon Rapids, MN
findings: ZIP 55448 (Coon Rapids) has 88 nonprofit organizations. 46 of them (52%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 36 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 55448 (Coon Rapids) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 55448 (Coon Rapids) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 61% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 25 organizations here; 31% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Hobby and sports organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 8 hobby and sports organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
